authority.format: First line exactly SLP-TESTED-SETTING-ATTESTATIONS-V1. Each following line is SRC-NNNN<TAB>setting<TAB>state, where setting is key=canonical-integer and state is TESTED-BEFORE-USE or NOT-TESTED-BEFORE-USE.
authority.missing: Missing, symlink, non-regular, unreadable, malformed, duplicate source id, control-byte content or missing target SRC row => ERROR, never implicit PASS.
authority.target_row: SRC-0034 must bind exactly kernel.randomize_va_space=2. TESTED-BEFORE-USE => PASS; NOT-TESTED-BEFORE-USE or a different tested setting => VALUE/FAIL.

compliance.error: ERROR when the explicit local attestation authority is absent or cannot be trusted syntactically/readably, or when SRC-0034 has no attestation row.
compliance.fail: VALUE/FAIL when SRC-0034 is explicitly NOT-TESTED-BEFORE-USE or is attested for a setting other than kernel.randomize_va_space=2.
compliance.pass: VALUE/PASS only when the explicit local authority contains exactly one SRC-0034 row binding kernel.randomize_va_space=2 to TESTED-BEFORE-USE.

source_interpretation.advisory_distinction: This contract is specific to SRC-0034 wording «после тестирования». It does not reinterpret SRC-0028 / 2.5.5 separate sentence «Рекомендуется предварительно проверить...» as a mandatory closure prerequisite; that row already records the sentence as advisory compatibility guidance.
source_interpretation.authority_role: The source does not prescribe a test method, evidence file format or path. The authority is a deterministic product mechanism for representing the local procedural fact; it is not a separate FSTEC requirement and CHECK does not claim to reconstruct the historical test independently.
source_interpretation.closure: SRC-0034 closes only as an exact two-control set: current sysctl equality kernel.randomize_va_space=2 plus this explicit TESTED-BEFORE-USE attestation. Neither control alone is source-complete.
source_interpretation.procedural_qualifier: The words «после тестирования» directly qualify use of kernel.randomize_va_space=2 and are therefore retained as a mandatory prerequisite instead of being discarded by a plain sysctl observer.

source_requirement: 2.5.11. Реализовать рандомизацию адресного пространства, которая защищает от атак на переполнение буфера, путём использования команды после тестирования kernel.randomize_va_space = 2.
